term: same actual reason across worlds of existence
definition: ActualStable m domain x means there is one rigid token r such that every world where x exists admits r as both actually present and explanatory. No claim about r or explanation is made at worlds where x is absent.
note: Source attribution paused under owner scope for #465; semantic test only. Actualist guards follow the fixed-roster membership convention of #599, extended to existing Reason tokens without changing Ontic.
